summary: A 21-year-old hiker from Pandora, Ohio, descending a rock face above Boulder Falls without technical gear, lost his footing and fell about 25 feet; his friend and nearby hikers stabilized him, rescuers litter-carried him to the top of the falls and lowered him over the falls on a high-line, and low-level lightning forced a transfer from helicopter to ground ambulance for transport to a Boulder-area hospital; the rescue took about five hours.
notes: Run 994 Mountain-Ear chunk: Mountain-Ear article reprinting the Boulder County Sheriff's Office release (BCSO case #20-3393); assisting agencies included Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Nederland Fire, Sugarloaf Fire, American Medical Response, Med Evac, Colorado State Patrol, and City of Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks.
